description: Installs the host-neutral bounded worktree lifecycle, prepare-before-worker routing, candidate-bound integration evidence, and exact Codex command rules.
delta: All workflow modes use meridian worktree prepare, check, integrate stage/finalize/abort, and cleanup. Coordinators prepare before launching a worker; workers must bind to and check the exact existing path before reading task material. Validation remains outside the allowlisted lifecycle command and is bound to the staged candidate tree.
verification: real temporary repositories cover prepare, check, stage, finalize, abort, and cleanup
worker routing rejects primary and substitute worktrees before task reads
Codex rules allow only the named Meridian lifecycle action prefixes and retain restrictive raw Git rules
python3 scripts/check_repository.py and the complete unit suite pass
